legal_ref: Ligji Nr. 05/L-037 për Tatimin mbi Vlerën e Shtuar, neni 26 (hyn në fuqi më 1 shtator 2015)
quote: Neni 26 Norma: 1. TVSH ngarkohet me normën standarde prej tetëmbëdhjetë përqind (18%). — VAT is charged at the standard rate of eighteen percent (18%). Final article: "Ky ligj hyn në fuqi më 1 shtator 2015."
source_title: Administrata Tatimore e Kosovës (atk-ks.org, Legjislacioni/Ligjet) — Ligji Nr. 05/L-037 për TVSH me shtojca

reduced_rates.scope: water (not bottled), electricity incl. transmission/distribution, district heating, waste collection; cereals and cereal products (flour, bread), cooking oils, milk and dairy, salt, eggs; school books and serial publications, library lending/books; IT equipment; medicines, pharmaceutical and medical/surgical devices; agricultural inputs/machinery (Art. 26(2) and annex)

notes: Mandatory registration when annual turnover exceeds EUR 30,000 (Art. 6(1)). Draft Law No. 08/L-005 on VAT, intended to replace 05/L-037, was put before the Assembly but no adoption was found (PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, reviewed 7 Aug 2026, still cites 05/L-037 with 18%/8%). ATK site TLS certificate fails validation; documents fetched directly.
unverified: Whether any later amendment to 05/L-037 changed Art. 26 — ATK publishes only the original 2015 text; PwC (secondary, Aug 2026) confirms 18%/8% still apply
